title: Box Office: ‘Super Mario Galaxy Movie’ Scores Massive $34 Million Opening Day
summary: That's the biggest start of the year so far after passing up 'Project Hail Mary.' It is also ahead of the first film, which transformed into a box office juggernaut.
contentText: The sequel blasted off to $34.5 million on Wednesday, the biggest opening day of the year so far after passing up 'Project Hail Mary.' And it is pacing on par with the first film, which transformed into a box office juggernaut.
